title: [Update] MOD AI - World Tab, New UI, Goblins and… Beta Is Getting Closer
author: Tigeline
selftext:
Hey everyone,  
Time for a quick roundup of what we’ve recently changed and added. A lot of things are coming together, and we’re slowly approaching the point where you’ll actually be able to play. Here’s what’s new:

**New UI and “World” Tab**  
After many of your suggestions, we’ve switched to a darker theme - the interface is now more readable, with centered text and clearer buttons. We also renamed the “Quests” tab to “World” - this is where all features related to exploration and the city will go. Got ideas for what could be included there? We’d love to hear them!

**Hero Panel**  
We’ve updated the character panel to allow as many customization options as possible. It’s not the final version - so if there’s anything you think is missing, let us know.

**Music and Loading Screen**  
We’ve added a welcome screen and background music. The options menu is also coming together - it’s not complete yet, but you can already check it out in-game.

**Goblins, Rats, and Wolves**  
The first monsters are entering the game world - for now, it’s goblins, rats, and wolves, but this is just the beginning. We have our own list of enemies, but if there are any creatures you think *must* be in the game - share your ideas!

**Beta Is Really Close Now**  
Thanks for all your comments and suggestions - they’re helping us shape the game. 

If you want to see more behind-the-scenes content, share feedback, and get ready for the beta, join us on Discord here: [https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN](https://discord.gg/QB54WXdYgN)

  
See you soon!
